		TAG-Bench: Generative Action Tell-Tales
	

Project page: https://xthomasbu.github.io/video-gen-evals/
TAG-Bench is a benchmark for human motion realism in video generative models.
It consists of 828 generated video clips of human actions, together with human ratings collected… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/dghadiya/TAG-Bench-Video.
reputation: Niche but relevant benchmark in the video generative models community; cited in works on human-motion realism and hosted on Hugging Face.
